assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and key-area polygons are provisional, derived from the announcement's textual limits and approximate areas; exact official CAD/GIS redlines have not been publicly released.
assumptions.impact: All area metrics, land-use proportions and spatial conclusions must be recalculated from the official polygon after it is released; provisional geometry must not be used as an official redline, approval basis or precise-area basis.

assumptions.statement: Floor-area ratio, building height, building density, green ratio, setback and road redline controls are not present in the public site package and require approved regulatory-plan conditions or official brief attachments.
assumptions.impact: All development-intensity and building-scale suggestions are conceptual frameworks pending official controls; the proposal does not fabricate approved values.

assumptions.statement: Parcel ownership, cadastral boundaries and current building survey data are not publicly available; retain/renovate/demolish judgments are methodological suggestions only.
assumptions.impact: Renovation and redevelopment classifications are conceptual directions for professional teams; no parcel-level ownership or demolition/renovation conclusion is made.
